webhooks.detail: Vonage POSTs webhooks to developer-configured URLs for inbound messages, message status/delivery receipts, voice answer/event callbacks.

evidence.quote: Webhooks are also used to notify your application of events such as an incoming call or message.

sandbox.detail: Messages API Sandbox free (WhatsApp, Viber, Messenger, Instagram), 100 msgs/month, 1 msg/s. Also free signup credit on new account.

evidence.quote: The Messages API Sandbox is free to use.

rate_limits.summary: Messages API: 75 req/s per API key default, raisable; 429 on exceed

evidence.quote: The default rate limit for requests to the Messages API is 75 requests per second per API key.
Quickly integrate Vonage APIs in your server-side applications.
